$comment: Plan W11.L3: every claim the M3 launch kit makes, with its receipt. `source` is a file in this repository and `quote` is text that file contains (whitespace aside), so a claim can't outlive what it rests on: `npm run launch:kit` (scripts/launch-kit.mjs) fails when a quote is gone. The kit's files mark each claim with [^id].

mit.en: Open source under the MIT licence.

no-account.en: No account; with the default settings nothing leaves the device.
no-account.quote: With default settings nothing leaves the device, which is what the local-only audit shows.

offline.en: Works offline as an installed web app.
offline.quote: | Installed web app (PWA) | the browser's **Install** button on the hosted app | the same OPFS; works offline |

md-files.en: Notes are plain Markdown; the whole vault exports as a .zip or a folder.
md-files.quote: Take the whole vault out as a .zip or a folder

rtl-per-line.en: Direction is set per line, from its first strong letter.
rtl-per-line.quote: In the source editor each line takes its direction from its first strong letter

hebrew-search.en: Search folds niqqud, final letters and the prefix letters.
hebrew-search.quote: Workspace search folds niqqud, final letters (ם/מ, ן/נ…) and the prefix letters ו ה ב כ ל מ ש

ui-languages.en: The interface is in 8 languages, six of them in beta (machine-translated); Hebrew and Arabic mirror the layout.
ui-languages.he: הממשק ב-8 שפות, שש מהן בבטא (תרגום מכונה); בעברית ובערבית הממשק מתהפך.
ui-languages.quote: English and Hebrew in full, and Arabic, Russian, French, German, Japanese and Chinese in beta

plugin-no-access.en: Every plugin runs with no access by default.
plugin-no-access.quote: Lumen runs every plugin with **no access by default**.

plugin-quickjs.en: Plugin logic runs in QuickJS, a separate engine in its own Web Worker, with no fetch, DOM or storage.
plugin-quickjs.quote: There is no `fetch`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `importScripts`, DOM or storage

plugin-ui-data.en: A plugin's interface is a tree of known elements, not HTML.
plugin-ui-data.quote: The plugin sends a **tree of known elements**

plugin-scorecards.en: Each listed plugin has a public review scorecard with a privacy label.
plugin-scorecards.quote: a review scorecard with a privacy label for each plugin

local-ai.en: AI can run entirely on the device (WebGPU), with no per-token cost.
local-ai.quote: Run AI prompts entirely on your device — private, offline-capable, no per-token cost.

vault-encryption.en: Optional vault encryption at rest, with AES-256-GCM.
vault-encryption.quote: AES-256-GCM, one random nonce per write

argon2id.en: The passphrase key is derived with Argon2id.

no-external-audit.en: Lumen has not had an external security audit, so its cryptography must not be called audited.
no-external-audit.quote: Lumen has not had an external security audit.

importers.en: Imports from Obsidian, Notion, Evernote, Bear, Apple Notes, Google Keep, Logseq and OneNote.
importers.quote: Bring notes from Obsidian, Notion, Evernote, Bear, Apple Notes, Google Keep, Logseq or OneNote

obsidian-corpus.en: Real public Obsidian vaults are opened and saved byte-identical in the test suite.
obsidian-corpus.quote: every note is read and written back byte-identical

compare.en: An honest comparison with Obsidian, Notion and Google Docs, with a source for every claim and what Lumen still lacks.
compare.quote: An honest comparison for people who write in Hebrew: what each one does, with a source for every claim, and what Lumen still lacks.

desktop.en: There is a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux.
desktop.quote: The desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) works like a native one.

findings-public.en: Every open security finding is listed in public.
